## Wiederholung der Kenntnisse

Erstellen einer Quarto Präsentation. Nutzen Sie iris\
- erstellen sie eine Abb. der Verteilung der Sepal.Length der spezies

## Lösung für die Grafik (mtcars)

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"

mtcars |> ggplot(aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = cyl))
```


## Lösung für iris

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"

iris |> ggplot(aes(Sepal.Length)) +
  geom_density(aes(color =Species))
```

## Verschönern mit ggthemes

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
# Values
library(ggthemes)
mtcars |> ggplot(aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = cyl)) +
  theme_bw()
```

## dep_delay

::: incremental
-   Verteilung
-   histogram
:::

## dep_delay

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |> ggplot(aes(dep_delay)) + geom_histogram()
```

# Rows

## Display

::: incremental
head(flights).\
tail(flights).\
slice_head(flights, n = 3).\
slice_max(flights, n = 3, order_by = dep_delay)
:::

## dep_delay \< 250

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |> filter(dep_delay < 250) |>
ggplot(aes(dep_delay)) + geom_histogram()
```

## Zwei Bedingungen entferne \< 0

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |> filter(dep_delay < 250 & dep_delay > 0 ) |>
ggplot(aes(dep_delay)) + geom_histogram()

```

## dep_delay in Jan, Feb kleiner 250 größer 0

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>    
    filter(dep_delay < 250 & dep_delay > 0 ) |> filter(month == 1 | month == 2) |>   
    ggplot(aes(dep_delay)) +    
    geom_histogram()
```

## Alternative

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |> 
  filter(dep_delay < 250 & dep_delay > 0 ) |>   
  filter(month %in% c(1,2)) |>    
  ggplot(aes(dep_delay)) +    
  geom_histogram()   
```

## Verspätungen nach Monat

Frage: Wie verhalten sich die Verspätungen gegenüber dem Monat, boxplot?

## Lösung ??

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"

flights |>
  ggplot(aes(month, dep_delay, color = month)) +   
  geom_boxplot()
```

## Gruppieren

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"

flights |>
  ggplot(aes(month, dep_delay, group = month)) +   
  geom_boxplot()
```

## Alternative

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"

flights |>
  ggplot(aes(as.factor(month), dep_delay)) +   
  geom_boxplot()
```


## Entfernen

flights \|\> select(-year)

flights \|\> select(year:day)

## Helper

flights \|\> select(where(is.character))\
flights \|\> select(starts_with("d"))\
flights \|\> select(where(is.numeric))

## Helper functions

-   starts_with("abc"): matches names that begin with “abc”.
-   ends_with("xyz"): matches names that end with “xyz”.
-   contains("ijk"): matches names that contain “ijk”.
-   num_range("x", 1:3): matches x1, x2 and x3.

## Beispiel

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>
select(contains("dep"))
```

# Neue Spalten berechnen

## mutate

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>
mutate( gain = dep_delay - arr_delay,
speed = distance / air_time * 60 )
```

## Übersichtlicher Position 1

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>
mutate( gain = dep_delay - arr_delay,
speed = distance / air_time * 60, .before = 1 )
```

## Wohin

flights \|\>\
mutate( gain = dep_delay - arr_delay,\
speed = distance / air_time \* 60, .after = day )

## Was

flights \|\>\
mutate( gain = dep_delay - arr_delay,\
speed = distance / air_time \* 60, .keep = "used" )

## Häufige Helfer

Wenn distance grösser 1000 dist_var = 1 sonst 0\

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>
mutate(dist_var = ifelse(distance <1000,1,0),.before = 1)
```

## Beispiel mit ifelse

## Verwandle Origin in eine Zahl

Vermeide geschachtelte ifelse

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>
mutate(origin_var = case_when(
origin == "EWR" ~ 1,
origin == "JFK" ~ 2,
origin == "LGA" ~ 3,
.default = 0),
.before = 1)
```

# Groups

## group_by

flights \|\>\
group_by(month)

## summarize

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>
group_by(month) |>
summarize(avg_delay = mean(dep_delay))
```

## Help

?summarize

## Lösung

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>
group_by(month) |>
summarize(avg_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Anzahl

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>
group_by(month) |>
summarize( Anzahl = n())
```

## Kürzer

flights \|\>\
count(month)\

count() ersetzt group_by \|\> summarize(x = n())

## most frequent carrier

## Lösung

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>
count(carrier) |>
arrange(desc(n))
```

## mean dep_delay for top 5 carrier

## Lösung

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>
group_by(carrier) |>
summarize(n =n(), mean_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
arrange(desc(n)) |> slice_max(n, n=5)
```

## Das ganze für jeden origin

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>
group_by(origin,carrier) |>
summarize(n =n(), mean_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
arrange(desc(n)) |>
slice_max(n, n=5)
```

## Mehrfachoperationen Median aller numerischen Spalten

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>
summarize(across(dep_time:arr_time, median, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Entferne die NA

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flights |>
filter(!if_any(dep_time:arr_time, is.na)) |>
summarize(across(dep_time:arr_time, mean))
```
